messages:
marta_support: FYI customer on Dedicated sees rerank requests fail when they batch 2+ inputs. error is a 400 about embedding dimension mismatch and some requests are slow (~2s). sample req ids: req_01A2BC, req_01A2BD. they attached a curl, dropping it here so infra/ml can triage.

kevin_infra: can you paste the exact curl + headers? need X-Request-ID from the failing calls and any timestamps. also which model did they select (embed model + rerank model).

marta_support: here's what they gave (token redacted):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_01A2BC" \
  -d '{\n    "model": "redwood-rerank-1",\n    "candidate_embeddings": [\n      {"id": "c1", "embedding": [0.1, 0.2, /* ... total 512 floats ... */]},\n      {"id": "c2", "embedding": [0.3, 0.4, /* ... total 768 floats ??? */]}\n    ],\n    "query_embedding": [0.01, 0.02, /* 512 floats */],\n    "top_k": 5\n  }'\n```

kevin_infra: that payload looks suspect — one candidate shows a different length. server log for req_01A2BC is: 

```
2026-09-12T14:02:11.234Z INFO RerankService received request id=req_01A2BC model=redwood-rerank-1 batch_size=2
2026-09-12T14:02:11.236Z ERROR EmbeddingValidator DimensionMismatchError expected=512 actual=768 candidate_id=c2
2026-09-12T14:02:11.236Z WARN RerankService returning 400 for req_01A2BC
```

elsa_ml: common root cause is client mixing embeddings from two model families (e.g., embed-512 vs embed-768) or a pre-processing bug that concatenates vectors. also batching logic that merges outputs from separate calls can cause this. ask the customer to verify they always call the same embedding model and not cache/merge embeddings across model versions.

marta_support: customer says they call our /v1/embeddings with model=redwood-embed-512 but they also have an old worker returning embed-768. they suspect a race when updating workers during rollout.

ryan_oncall: we should verify server-side that we reject mixed-dimension batches earlier and surface clearer error. for now, ask customer to reproduce with a minimal curl that sends two candidates both generated fresh from the same embed model. sample repro curl they can run: 

```bash
# generate two embeddings (client side) then rerank, make sure dims match
# (examples below are illustrative, replace EMBED_TOKEN)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-512","input":["first text","second text"]}' \
  | jq '.' > embeds.json

# verify both vectors length == 512, then:
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: reproduce_01" \
  -d @embeds_for_rerank.json
```

kevin_infra: created a debug bundle for req_01A2BC and req_01A2BD: s3://redwood-debug/debug-bundles/1800001234-req_01A2BC.tar.gz and s3://redwood-debug/debug-bundles/1800001234-req_01A2BD.tar.gz (contains server logs, trace spans, and model-kv metadata). debug-bot: bundle available.

debug-bot: debug bundle created: s3://redwood-debug/debug-bundles/1800001234-req_01A2BC.tar.gz (retention 7d)

marta_support: thanks kevin. @elsa_ml can you check model metadata in the bundle for whether the rerank node pulled an incompatible embedding schema? pay attention to model_version and quantization profile.

elsa_ml: grabbing bundle now. early look: rerank config shows expected_embed_dim=512, but there's a stray embedding source labelled "embed-service-v2" with output_dim=768. that matches the candidate id=c2 in logs. looks like client is indeed mixing sources or a proxy in front of them is returning a stale worker. recommend we: 1) ask customer to confirm no intermediate caching/proxy, 2) recommend server-side improvement: validate dims before batching and return a clearer error message including which candidate id mismatched.

marta_support: agreed. i've sent customer a repro checklist and the single-command repro curl. asked them to run with `--verbose` and paste X-Request-ID if it fails. also offered to collect a debug bundle from their Dedicated instance (requires their OK).

ryan_oncall: also flagging this for the next oncall infra patch: add a pre-batch dimension check and a metric for "mixed-embedding-dimension" to catch in telemetry.

marta_support: customer replied: ran the simple flow, still saw one failure (req ID reproduce_02). attached verbose curl output; they confirmed both embeddings came from the same embed endpoint but one worker was returning 768. they are running a blue/green of their inference workers — likely root cause.

kevin_infra: noted. I'll add a guard in the batching layer to reject mismatched dims with an explicit error and include candidate_id in the message. estimate a small patch and deploy to staging today.

marta_support: perfect. I'll loop back to the customer with mitigation steps and request they run the repro curl after their rollout completes. will update here when we have the patch in staging. :thumbsup:
